extracted.name: Tomato Chutney
extracted.description: This tomato chutney is super simple to make with freshly chopped tomatoes, ginger, garlic, sugar, and spices for a sweet and flavorful condiment.
instruction_lines: Combine tomatoes, ginger, garlic, cilantro, chili powder, sugar, and salt in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until thick and tomatoes have broken down, about 10 minutes.
